stories.title: Multnomah County Sheriff's Office urges shoppers to watch for holiday theft, scams ahead of Black Friday
stories.summary: From fraudulent delivery messages to stolen packages, the sheriff's office is urging shoppers to take precautions during the holiday season.

stories.title: How to watch the Portland tree lighting ceremony on Friday
stories.summary: KGW will stream the annual tree lighting ceremony live starting at 5:30 p.m. on Nov. 27.

stories.title: Affordable housing coming to Southeast Portland for ‘invisible homeless population’
stories.summary: Path Home will soon break ground on 38 affordable homes for families leaving homelessness.

stories.title: Beaverton police arrest 19 people in holiday retail theft operation
stories.summary: Police recovered thousands of dollars in merchandise and are reminding shoppers to protect holiday deliveries from package theft.

stories.title: Portland delays decision on new Broadway-capable theater at PSU
stories.summary: Following years of review and research, city leaders are pushing back their timeline on next steps and funding for the proposed PSU Performing Arts + Culture Center.

stories.title: US Army releases post-detonation maps of potential lead dust exposure
stories.summary: The Army and EPA have said that initial monitoring has not shown any concentrations of lead in the air. Surface sampling and testing is still underway.

stories.title: Cannon Beach visitor and dog swept up in sneaker wave after warning about king tides
stories.summary: The Cannon Beach Police Department shared dramatic video of the incident, where a man and his dog were washed down the shore. Both are alright, the agency said.

stories.title: Thanksgiving dinner costs are up 6%. Here's how Portland shoppers can save
stories.summary: From buying in bulk to avoiding misleading grocery deals, Portland grocery experts share money-saving tips and reveal which holiday staples are cheaper this year.

stories.title: Washington State Ferries warn about impact of king tides on holiday travel
stories.summary: Thanksgiving travel is getting underway in Washington, but unusually high and low tides could complicate trips for thousands of ferry passengers over the holiday.

stories.title: 5 years after Oakley Carlson vanished, new prosecutor offers hope for justice
stories.summary: Dec. 6 marks five years since Oakley Carlson was reported missing. A $100,000 reward is offered for tips on her whereabouts.

stories.title: Lawsuit claims sudden closure of Portland residential treatment center led to relapse, homelessness
stories.summary: The women's residential treatment center operated by Volunteers of America Oregon in Northeast Portland abruptly shut down in April.

stories.title: New universal healthcare plan would save 80% of Oregonians on costs, report estimates
stories.summary: A volunteer board tasked with developing a single-payer healthcare system for Oregon has published its plan for how the state could tackle it.
